capabilities: Focus files and folders in the file explorer with a single left click
Return keyboard focus to the file explorer after opening a file
Rename the selected item by pressing Enter
Expand or collapse folders only via the arrow icon
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README includes a demo section but only its caption text is present.
intentEvidence: The default Obsidian file explorer requires multiple clicks to rename a file or folder.
motivation: The author wanted the file explorer to behave like native macOS Finder, where one click selects and focuses an item for instant renaming.
problem: The default file explorer needs multiple clicks before a file or folder can be renamed with the keyboard.

relations.evidence: match the native macOS Finder interaction model

summary: File explorer tweak that makes a single left click focus a file or folder so Enter renames it immediately.
